corporation.en: The corporation published its annual report before the shareholder meeting.
corporation.zh: 這家公司在股東會前公布了年度報告。

correlation.en: The study found a correlation between sleep quality and concentration.
correlation.zh: 這項研究發現睡眠品質與專注力之間有相關性。

correspondent.en: The correspondent sent a detailed report from the international conference.
correspondent.zh: 那位記者從國際會議傳回了一份詳細報導。

cosmetics.en: The store placed its cosmetics near the front entrance for convenience.
cosmetics.zh: 商店為了方便，把化妝品放在前方入口附近。

costly.en: Ignoring small maintenance problems can become costly over time.
costly.zh: 忽略小型維修問題，久而久之可能代價高昂。

costume.en: Each student designed a costume for the school performance.
costume.zh: 每位學生都為學校表演設計了一套服裝。

couch.en: We moved the couch closer to the window for better light.
couch.zh: 我們把沙發移到更靠近窗戶的地方，以獲得更好的光線。

cough.en: A persistent cough can make it difficult to focus in class.
cough.zh: 持續咳嗽可能讓人在課堂上難以專心。

counselor.en: The school counselor helped students plan their future course choices.
counselor.zh: 學校輔導老師協助學生規劃未來的選課方向。

countable.en: The teacher explained which nouns are countable in this grammar exercise.
countable.zh: 老師說明這份文法練習中哪些名詞是可數的。

counter.en: The cashier placed the receipt on the counter beside the register.
counter.zh: 收銀員把收據放在收銀機旁的櫃檯上。

countryside.en: Many families visit the countryside during long weekends for fresh air.
countryside.zh: 許多家庭會在連假到鄉間呼吸新鮮空氣。

county.en: The county opened a new public library near the central station.
county.zh: 這個郡在中央車站附近開設了一間新的公共圖書館。

coupon.en: She used a coupon to reduce the price of her lunch.
coupon.zh: 她使用折價券降低午餐的價格。

courageous.en: It was courageous of him to admit the mistake publicly.
courageous.zh: 他公開承認錯誤是很有勇氣的。

courteous.en: The staff remained courteous even when the office became crowded.
courteous.zh: 即使辦公室變得擁擠，工作人員仍保持有禮。

courtyard.en: Students gathered in the courtyard before the school ceremony began.
courtyard.zh: 學校典禮開始前，學生聚集在中庭。

cousin.en: My cousin studies engineering and enjoys building small robots.
cousin.zh: 我的表親就讀工程相關科系，也喜歡製作小型機器人。

cow.en: The farmer led the cow back to the field after feeding.
cow.zh: 農夫餵食後把那頭牛帶回田野。

cowardly.en: The story criticizes the cowardly decision to abandon the team.
cowardly.zh: 這個故事批評那個拋棄團隊的懦弱決定。

cowboy.en: The museum displayed an old cowboy hat from the western frontier.
cowboy.zh: 博物館展示了一頂來自西部拓荒時期的老牛仔帽。

cozy.en: The small reading room feels cozy on cold winter afternoons.
cozy.zh: 寒冷的冬日下午，這間小閱覽室感覺很舒適。

crab.en: A small crab moved quickly across the wet sand.
crab.zh: 一隻小螃蟹快速爬過濕潤的沙地。

crack.en: A thin crack appeared in the wall after the earthquake.
crack.zh: 地震後，牆上出現了一道細裂縫。

crackdown.en: The city announced a crackdown on illegal dumping near the river.
crackdown.zh: 市政府宣布將加強取締河邊非法棄置垃圾的行為。

cracker.en: He ate a cracker with cheese during the afternoon break.
cracker.zh: 他在下午休息時間吃了一片搭配起司的餅乾。

cradle.en: The museum displayed an old wooden cradle from a rural home.
cradle.zh: 博物館展示了一個來自鄉村家庭的老木搖籃。

cram.en: Students should review regularly instead of trying to cram overnight.
cram.zh: 學生應該規律複習，而不是試圖在一夜之間硬塞知識。

cramp.en: A leg cramp forced the runner to stop and stretch.
cramp.zh: 腿部抽筋迫使跑者停下來伸展。

crash.en: The sudden computer crash interrupted the presentation for several minutes.
crash.zh: 電腦突然當機，讓簡報中斷了好幾分鐘。

crater.en: The telescope revealed a large crater near the moon's surface edge.
crater.zh: 望遠鏡顯示月球表面邊緣附近有一個大型隕石坑。

crayon.en: The child used a blue crayon to color the ocean.
crayon.zh: 那個孩子用藍色蠟筆替海洋上色。

crazy.en: The schedule became crazy after three meetings were added unexpectedly.
crazy.zh: 臨時增加三場會議後，行程變得非常混亂。

cream.en: She added a little cream to the soup before serving it.
cream.zh: 上桌前，她在湯裡加了一點鮮奶油。

creation.en: The creation of the new website took several months of planning.
creation.zh: 新網站的建立花了好幾個月規劃。

creator.en: The creator explained how the animation was developed from early sketches.
creator.zh: 創作者說明這部動畫如何從早期草圖發展而來。

creature.en: The documentary introduced a deep-sea creature rarely seen by humans.
creature.zh: 紀錄片介紹了一種人類很少見到的深海生物。

credibility.en: Clear evidence can improve the credibility of a research report.
credibility.zh: 清楚的證據可以提升研究報告的可信度。

creep.en: Shadows began to creep across the field as evening approached.
creep.zh: 傍晚接近時，陰影開始慢慢爬過田野。

crew.en: The flight crew completed a safety check before passengers boarded.
crew.zh: 乘客登機前，機組人員完成了安全檢查。

criminal.en: The article discussed how courts evaluate evidence in a criminal case.
criminal.zh: 這篇文章討論法院如何評估刑事案件中的證據。

cripple.en: A major power failure could cripple the entire transportation system.
cripple.zh: 大規模停電可能使整個交通系統癱瘓。

crispy.en: The vegetables stayed crispy after a short time in the oven.
crispy.zh: 蔬菜在烤箱中短時間烘烤後仍保持酥脆。

crocodile.en: The zoo built a larger habitat for its adult crocodile.
crocodile.zh: 動物園為成年的鱷魚建造了更大的棲息地。

crown.en: The museum displayed a jeweled crown behind thick glass.
crown.zh: 博物館把一頂鑲有珠寶的王冠展示在厚玻璃後方。

cruel.en: The novel shows how cruel behavior can harm an entire community.
cruel.zh: 這本小說呈現殘酷行為如何傷害整個社群。

cruelty.en: The campaign raises awareness about cruelty toward animals.
cruelty.zh: 這項活動提升人們對虐待動物問題的關注。

cruise.en: The family planned a short cruise during the summer vacation.
cruise.zh: 這個家庭計畫在暑假安排一次短程郵輪旅行。

crunchy.en: The salad includes crunchy vegetables and a light dressing.
crunchy.zh: 這份沙拉包含爽脆的蔬菜和清爽的醬汁。

crush.en: Heavy boxes can crush fragile items if they are stacked carelessly.
crush.zh: 如果堆放不慎，重箱子可能壓壞易碎物品。

crutch.en: He used a crutch while recovering from a leg injury.
crutch.zh: 腿傷復原期間，他使用拐杖行走。

cry.en: The baby's cry could be heard from the next room.
cry.zh: 從隔壁房間可以聽見嬰兒的哭聲。

crystal.en: The science lab displayed a clear crystal under a bright lamp.
crystal.zh: 科學實驗室在明亮的燈下展示了一顆透明晶體。

cub.en: The bear cub stayed close to its mother near the river.
cub.zh: 那隻小熊在河邊緊跟著母熊。

cube.en: The teacher used a wooden cube to explain three-dimensional shapes.
cube.zh: 老師用木製立方體說明三維形狀。

cucumber.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
cucumber.zh: 她切了一條小黃瓜並加入沙拉中。

cue.en: The actor waited for a clear cue before entering the stage.
cue.zh: 演員等到明確提示後才走上舞台。

cuisine.en: The festival introduced visitors to local cuisine from several regions.
cuisine.zh: 這場節慶向遊客介紹來自不同地區的在地料理。

cultivate.en: Schools can cultivate curiosity by encouraging students to ask questions.
cultivate.zh: 學校可以透過鼓勵學生提問來培養好奇心。

cultural.en: The museum offers cultural programs for students throughout the year.
cultural.zh: 博物館全年為學生提供文化活動。

cunning.en: The fox is portrayed as cunning in many traditional stories.
cunning.zh: 在許多傳統故事中，狐狸被描寫得很狡猾。

cupboard.en: The cups are stored in the cupboard beside the sink.
cupboard.zh: 杯子收在水槽旁的櫥櫃裡。

curb.en: New rules were introduced to curb unnecessary energy use.
curb.zh: 新規定被推出以抑制不必要的能源使用。

cure.en: Researchers are still looking for a cure for the disease.
cure.zh: 研究人員仍在尋找這種疾病的治療方法。

curfew.en: The youth camp has a curfew at ten every night.
curfew.zh: 這個青年營每天晚上十點有門禁時間。

curiosity.en: Her curiosity led her to read more about astronomy.
curiosity.zh: 她的好奇心促使她閱讀更多天文學相關內容。

curl.en: A small curl of smoke rose from the candle.
curl.zh: 一小縷煙從蠟燭上方捲起。

currency.en: Travelers should check the local currency before exchanging money.
currency.zh: 旅客在換錢前應先確認當地貨幣。

curriculum.en: The school updated its science curriculum to include more experiments.
curriculum.zh: 學校更新了科學課程，加入更多實驗。

curry.en: The restaurant serves a mild curry with vegetables and rice.
curry.zh: 這家餐廳供應搭配蔬菜和白飯的溫和咖哩。

curse.en: The old legend describes a curse placed on the abandoned castle.
curse.zh: 這則古老傳說描述一個施加在廢棄城堡上的詛咒。

curtain.en: She opened the curtain to let morning sunlight enter the room.
curtain.zh: 她拉開窗簾，讓晨光進入房間。

curve.en: The road follows a gentle curve around the hillside.
curve.zh: 這條道路沿著山坡形成一個平緩彎道。

cushion.en: He placed a cushion behind his back for extra support.
cushion.zh: 他在背後放了一個靠墊增加支撐。

custody.en: The museum kept the rare document in secure custody overnight.
custody.zh: 博物館把這份稀有文件整夜安全保管。

customary.en: It is customary to remove shoes before entering some homes.
customary.zh: 進入某些家庭前脫鞋是一種常見習俗。

customs.en: Travelers must follow customs rules when bringing goods across borders.
customs.zh: 旅客攜帶物品跨境時必須遵守海關規定。

cute.en: The bookstore sells cute notebooks with small animal illustrations.
cute.zh: 這家書店販售有小動物插圖的可愛筆記本。

cynical.en: His cynical comment suggested that he doubted everyone's intentions.
cynical.zh: 他那句憤世嫉俗的評論顯示他懷疑每個人的動機。

dairy.en: The store keeps dairy products in a refrigerated section.
dairy.zh: 商店把乳製品放在冷藏區。

dam.en: The dam controls river flow and stores water for nearby towns.
dam.zh: 這座水壩控制河流水量，並為附近城鎮儲水。

damage.en: Heavy rain caused damage to several roads near the mountain.
damage.zh: 豪雨造成山區附近多條道路受損。

damp.en: The basement remained damp after several days of rain.
damp.zh: 連續幾天下雨後，地下室仍然很潮濕。

dare.en: Few students dare to speak without preparing their ideas first.
dare.zh: 很少學生敢在沒有先準備想法的情況下發言。

daring.en: The climber made a daring decision to attempt the difficult route.
daring.zh: 那位登山者做出大膽決定，要挑戰困難路線。

darkness.en: The sudden darkness made it difficult to find the exit.
darkness.zh: 突如其來的黑暗讓人難以找到出口。

darling.en: The old song became a darling of local radio listeners.
darling.zh: 那首老歌成了當地廣播聽眾的最愛。

dash.en: He made a quick dash across the courtyard before the rain started.
dash.zh: 下雨前，他快速衝過中庭。

data.en: The team collected data from three different experiments before drawing conclusions.
data.zh: 團隊在下結論前，從三個不同實驗蒐集資料。

database.en: The library database helps students locate books and research articles quickly.
database.zh: 圖書館資料庫能幫助學生快速找到書籍和研究文章。

deadline.en: The project deadline was moved to Friday after the schedule changed.
deadline.zh: 行程變更後，專題截止日改到星期五。

dealer.en: The art dealer explained the history of the painting to visitors.
dealer.zh: 藝術品商人向訪客說明那幅畫的歷史。

dean.en: The dean welcomed new students at the beginning of the semester.
dean.zh: 院長在學期開始時歡迎新生。

debate.en: The class held a debate about the benefits of public transportation.
debate.zh: 全班進行了一場關於大眾運輸優點的辯論。

debris.en: Workers removed debris from the road after the storm.
debris.zh: 暴風雨後，工人清除了道路上的碎片。

decay.en: Moisture can cause wooden structures to decay over many years.
decay.zh: 濕氣可能讓木造結構經年累月逐漸腐朽。

deceive.en: The advertisement may deceive customers if important details are hidden.
deceive.zh: 如果隱藏重要細節，這則廣告可能會欺騙消費者。

decent.en: The hotel offers decent rooms at a reasonable price.
decent.zh: 這家旅館以合理價格提供品質不錯的房間。

decimal.en: The calculator displays the answer as a decimal instead of a fraction.
decimal.zh: 計算機把答案顯示成小數，而不是分數。

deck.en: Passengers gathered on the deck to watch the sunset.
deck.zh: 乘客聚集在甲板上欣賞夕陽。

decorate.en: Students will decorate the classroom before the school festival begins.
decorate.zh: 校慶開始前，學生會布置教室。

decoration.en: The handmade decoration was placed above the classroom door.
decoration.zh: 手作裝飾被放在教室門上方。

decrease.en: Regular maintenance can decrease the risk of unexpected equipment failure.
decrease.zh: 定期維護可以降低設備突然故障的風險。

dedication.en: Her dedication to daily practice gradually improved her performance.
dedication.zh: 她對每日練習的投入逐漸提升了表現。

deed.en: The story praises a generous deed performed without expecting a reward.
deed.zh: 這個故事讚揚一件不求回報的慷慨善行。

deepen.en: Reading different viewpoints can deepen your understanding of an issue.
deepen.zh: 閱讀不同觀點可以加深你對議題的理解。

defect.en: Engineers found a small defect during the final product inspection.
defect.zh: 工程師在產品最終檢查時發現一個小瑕疵。

defensive.en: The team adopted a defensive strategy after taking an early lead.
defensive.zh: 球隊早早領先後採取了防守策略。

deficiency.en: The report identified a deficiency in the building's ventilation system.
deficiency.zh: 報告指出該建築的通風系統有一項不足。

definite.en: We need a definite answer before making the final reservation.
definite.zh: 在完成最後預訂前，我們需要一個明確答案。

definition.en: The textbook provides a clear definition for each scientific term.
definition.zh: 課本為每個科學術語提供清楚的定義。

delegate.en: The club will delegate several tasks to different student teams.
delegate.zh: 社團會把幾項工作分派給不同學生小組。

delicate.en: The delicate glass model must be moved with great care.
delicate.zh: 這個精緻的玻璃模型搬動時必須非常小心。

delight.en: The unexpected message brought delight to the entire class.
delight.zh: 這則意外的消息讓全班都感到喜悅。

delivery.en: The delivery arrived earlier than expected on Friday morning.
delivery.zh: 這批貨在星期五早上比預期更早送達。

demanding.en: The course is demanding, but students learn useful research skills.
demanding.zh: 這門課要求很高，但學生能學到實用的研究技巧。

democracy.en: The lesson introduced basic ideas about democracy and civic participation.
democracy.zh: 這堂課介紹民主與公民參與的基本概念。

democratic.en: The club used a democratic process to choose its new leader.
democratic.zh: 社團用民主程序選出新的領導者。

density.en: Scientists measured the density of each sample in the laboratory.
density.zh: 科學家在實驗室測量每個樣本的密度。

dentist.en: The dentist explained how regular brushing helps protect teeth.
dentist.zh: 牙醫說明規律刷牙如何幫助保護牙齒。

departure.en: The train's departure was delayed by heavy rain.
departure.zh: 火車因豪雨而延誤發車。

dependence.en: Excessive dependence on one source can weaken a research project.
dependence.zh: 過度依賴單一資料來源可能削弱研究專題。

deposit.en: The hotel requires a small deposit when guests make reservations.
deposit.zh: 旅客訂房時，旅館會要求支付一小筆訂金。

depression.en: The article discusses economic depression as a historical topic.
depression.zh: 這篇文章以歷史議題的角度討論經濟蕭條。

derive.en: Researchers can derive useful conclusions from carefully organized data.
derive.zh: 研究人員可以從妥善整理的資料推導出有用結論。

descend.en: The hikers began to descend before the weather became worse.
descend.zh: 天氣惡化前，登山者開始下山。

description.en: The report includes a detailed description of the experimental procedure.
description.zh: 報告包含對實驗程序的詳細描述。

deserted.en: The station looked deserted after the final train had left.
deserted.zh: 末班車離開後，車站看起來空無一人。

designer.en: The designer presented three possible layouts for the new website.
designer.zh: 設計師提出三種新網站可能的版面配置。

destination.en: The bus reached its final destination shortly before noon.
destination.zh: 公車在中午前不久抵達最終目的地。

destructive.en: Strong winds can be destructive when they strike weak buildings.
destructive.zh: 強風襲擊結構脆弱的建築時可能造成嚴重破壞。

detail.en: Please check every detail before submitting the final report.
detail.zh: 提交最終報告前，請檢查每個細節。

detective.en: The novel follows a detective who solves a complicated mystery.
detective.zh: 這本小說描寫一位偵探解開複雜謎團的故事。

detention.en: The school uses detention only after repeated rule violations.
detention.zh: 學校只會在反覆違規後才使用留校處分。

devotion.en: Her devotion to the project impressed the entire research team.
devotion.zh: 她對專題的投入讓整個研究團隊留下深刻印象。

diagram.en: The diagram shows how energy moves through the system.
diagram.zh: 這張圖表顯示能量如何在系統中流動。

dialogue.en: The story uses dialogue to reveal the characters' different viewpoints.
dialogue.zh: 這個故事透過對話呈現角色不同的觀點。

diary.en: She kept a diary to record important events during the trip.
diary.zh: 她寫日記記錄旅途中重要的事情。

dictionary.en: A dictionary can help students confirm spelling and common meanings.
dictionary.zh: 字典可以幫助學生確認拼字和常見字義。

differ.en: The two plans differ mainly in cost and completion time.
differ.zh: 這兩個計畫主要在成本與完成時間上不同。

digital.en: The school introduced a digital system for submitting homework online.
digital.zh: 學校導入數位系統，讓學生在線上繳交作業。

dignity.en: Everyone deserves to be treated with respect and dignity.
dignity.zh: 每個人都應受到尊重並保有尊嚴。

dilemma.en: The team faced a dilemma between speed and accuracy.
dilemma.zh: 團隊面臨速度與準確度之間的兩難。

diligent.en: The diligent student reviewed her notes before every quiz.
diligent.zh: 那位勤奮的學生在每次小考前都會複習筆記。

diploma.en: Graduates received a diploma at the end of the ceremony.
diploma.zh: 畢業生在典禮結束時領到畢業證書。

diplomat.en: The diplomat attended a meeting about regional cooperation.
diplomat.zh: 那位外交官出席了一場關於區域合作的會議。

directory.en: The online directory lists contact information for each school office.
directory.zh: 線上名錄列出每個學校辦公室的聯絡資訊。

disability.en: The building added ramps to improve access for people with disability.
disability.zh: 這棟建築增設斜坡，以改善身心障礙者的通行。

disagreement.en: A calm discussion helped resolve the disagreement between the two groups.
disagreement.zh: 冷靜討論有助於解決兩組之間的意見不合。

disappearance.en: The sudden disappearance of the files caused confusion in the office.
disappearance.zh: 檔案突然消失，讓辦公室一陣混亂。

disappoint.en: Poor preparation can disappoint teammates who are depending on you.
disappoint.zh: 準備不足可能讓依賴你的隊友失望。

disaster.en: The city updated its disaster plan after the severe storm.
disaster.zh: 嚴重暴風雨後，市政府更新了災害應變計畫。

discount.en: Students receive a discount when they show a valid school card.
discount.zh: 學生出示有效學生證即可獲得折扣。

discovery.en: The discovery changed how scientists understood the ancient site.
discovery.zh: 這項發現改變了科學家對古代遺址的理解。
